name: AntsRoute
description: AntsRoute is route planning and optimization software that helps businesses schedule appointments, organize deliveries, and manage field service operations.

events.d: Update comments, custom fields, packages or the external ID of an order.
Create a service, delivery or collect in the planning on a date, or in the basket.
Schedule an order to a chosen date (exact or relative to today) as unassigned.
Retrieve an order by AntsRoute ID or External ID; optionally select which order fields to return.
Find orders by scheduled date range, status, selected fields, and pagination options.
Get the customer tracking link of an order in a chosen language.
Delete or archive an order, with options to purge it or cancel it in a started route.
Get a customer by AntsRoute ID or external ID.
Retrieve an agent's route for a chosen date. Configure agent email, date (exact or relative), and returned fields.
